turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brings you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: This afternoon, I'm just here because I've been experiencing some breathlessness as well as a bit of cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, when did it start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I think it's a it started around three months ago and I believe it's just been getting worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um, how often are you experiencing the shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I feel it like a lot of the time, especially outside when I'm in the cold or at at night when I go outside at night, my chest feels a little tight too at the same time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long does it last?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say it lasts up to an hour every time I'm out in the cold and then once I come back in. So I'd say it lasts at least one hour.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, does anything else make it worse, like dust? You know, laying down anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes when I'm near dust, sometimes when I'm running during gym class, increased activity does make it worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK. And if you were to describe the quality of your breathing difficulties, is it more like a burning kind of feeling? Is it like you can't catch your breath? What does it feel like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think it's more just a I can't catch my breath and it feels like my my throat is just kind of like closing off and I can't take deep breaths.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, that's scary. And one to 10, 10 being the worst, how bad is your shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It can get up to I would say like an 8 at times. It can get pretty scary. And sometimes, like I feel like heaviness in my chest too when it happens.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, and the coughing, has it been going on for as long as your breathlessness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say around the same same time frame like 3 months, but I'm not always coughing. It comes and goes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and for your coughing, is it kind of like the same triggers, the cold, dust, things like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I would say so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you ever have do you ever cough up blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't. It's mostly just a dry cough. I don't cough up anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK so no sputum or phlegm, no? OK, do you ever feel wheezy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I I I do hear like a like a weird sound when I breathe out sometimes, I I think it might be wheeziness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK. Do you have a sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no I don't have a sore throat, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? Um, how about a runny nose or stuffy nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes in your smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no changes in my smell, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. How about hearing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no hearing is fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and like no pus or liquid's coming out of your ear or anything like that, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No ear pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about your vision, everything OK there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, everything is OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any fevers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't know about a fever, I haven't checked, but some nights I do, especially in the last week I have woken up feeling a bit chilly. I haven't really checked.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you woke up feeling chilly, any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any weight loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about changes in your skin? Like have you noticed a rash anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not that I've really noticed no, no rashes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and any chest pain at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, just sometimes when I I'm coughing a lot I feel a little bit of just tension and heaviness in there. But that's just when I'm like really coughing a lot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah OK, and any any feelings like your heart's racing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? OK. And how about swelling? Have you noticed swelling anywhere in your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? OK um, OK, how about um, does your shortness of breath get worse when you're falling asleep?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that. I think it's mainly just worse if I go out in the cold or I'm like running around, doing more activities.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Does it ever wake you up at night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No never.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no nausea or vomitting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about changes in your in your bowel movement?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, bowel movements are normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about in terms of urinating, any changes there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? Any dizziness or fainting spells?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Confusion, memory loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good are you otherwise healthy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I don't have any other condition, I I do remember my doctors saying I have hay fever before, but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: When was that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think that was like more than three years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um, any recent surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? Are you on any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I just take some Tylenol sometimes for the like Tylenol cold, sometimes for the symptoms. I don't think it has really helped.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? OK, do you have any allergies? Not just to medications, but to anything else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh just like hay fever but nothing, nothing else that I can think of, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um, are you up to date with all your immunizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: As far as I know, yeah everything's up to date.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any family history of lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, don't think so. My sister, I think she they were saying she might have asthma and she also has eczema. No one else in the family has any other conditions.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Not not even like heart conditions, cancer?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, uh no, not that I know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK, have you been in contact with anyone who's been sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK, and any travel recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been here in Ontario.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and where do you live?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I currently live in London, but I just recently moved into a new flat around two months ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Two months ago, OK. Um, is it more is it an older flat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, it's fairly new. But one thing I did notice, I don't know if this has anything to do with it, but my flatmate actually smokes. Sometimes that can really irritate and make me cough more sometimes at night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, any any pets?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh no, I don't have any pets.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and and do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't smoke, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, never tried marijuana.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't smoke marijuana or cigarettes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about alcohol? Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, just like, maybe sometimes at parties, but very rarely. Maybe I would say once a month.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK. Um, and is there anything that you wanted to discuss today that I missed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, so no, I think that that was all like just the shortness of breath was scaring me a lot. But yeah, just the coughing, but other than that I just want to know what's going on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, and you mentioned you are otherwise healthy so you don't have any history of asthma or anything like that, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no ones ever told me that, but my sister has asthma, so I was wondering, maybe?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, have you ever experienced shortness of breath when you were younger with like exercise?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not really. Just maybe like the normal amount. Like if I'm running around too much, I feel shortness of breath, but I think it just got worse over the last few months.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and then have you ever had any imaging done in the past like a chest X-Ray or investigations like a pulmonary function test?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't recall having any of that done.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK alright well those are all the questions I had for you. If you didn't have anything else to add, I guess we will conclude by saying that what you have, we have a differential diagnosis for this. Um, it sounds like what you have is asthma. Since your symptoms started three months ago when you moved into a flat with your friends, and it seems like this smoking and cold is triggering that and so we'll work you up with a pulmonary function test to start and we'll see if bronchodilators will help with your symptoms. And if it doesn't, we'll also rule out other things like pneumonia or like allergic rhinitis. How does that sound?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, sounds great. Well, we'll see you soon then.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Alright, thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Take care.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: You too.
